title: Playing with O'Gee Sosia and Buddy Bo
summary: Joe played with O'Gee and Sunder Labatt, then with Buddy Bo, using free rail travel to reach weekend jobs at the Kill.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Well before that, I'm way ahead of my story. After with Paul Maurice. After with... O'Gees. As you... What's his name? August. August. August. August. August. August. August. August. August. August. And, however, I played with him. And likewise, Sunder. I played with both of those. Sunder Labatt. Yes. Sunder Labatt. And with O'Gees. And after... I'd gone to New Orleans and lived a while. They would send for me from New Orleans to come over out here and play with him. Oh. Now Buddy Bo.

Edgar Benwell. There's a little story behind working with him. We were playing out in the kill. Kill, Mississippi. Uh-huh. Well, naturally I used to come up down the railroad. It didn't cost me anything. I had free transportation. I had to come out here. And, uh, he got me to work with him out in the kill. So, every Saturday, after I knocked on work, I'd come out here and we'd go out to the kill and play. So, it happened to be... One weekend we had a terrific rain storm, I'd say. It started beginning about Thursday morning, on up until Friday evening. And, it seemed to be a low land in that section going over to the kill. The road was flooded. So, I came over this Friday evening because I... The trains had quite a number of trains at that time. I came out on the 3-30 train and contacted Buddy Bo, Edgar. And, uh, he told me, you know, he thought the dance might have been off, but he told me, he suggested I come over anyhow. So, the Saturday evening I came over.
Is that...is that...is that...is that cutting you off, but is that, uh, when he came for me out there and I wouldn't go?
It could have been, but that's the time we left to get rounded out there.
Yeah. Well, uh, make a long story short. You were not working for Lid Office.
What is Lid Office? That's the name of the man he worked for. The name of the man I was with.
Okay, yeah. I just want to get it down.
